'''Healing the Healer!''' (Japanese: '''伝説ゲット！？水の守護神スイクンを探せ！！''' ''Catch the Legend!? Find the Guardian of Water - Suicune!!'') is the sixteenth chapter of the {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}} manga. It is based on the [[JN053|animated series episode by the same name]].

==Plot==
{{Incomplete plot}}

==Major events==
* [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught|catches}} a {{TP|Goh|Suicune}}.
* Goh attempts to {{pkmn2|released|release}} his Suicune, but it chooses to remain his Pokémon while {{pkmn2|roaming}} the {{pkmn|world}}.

==Differences between the animated series and the manga==
* [[Goh's Raichu]] and {{rf|Alolan}} {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Alolan Exeggutor|Exeggutor}} are omitted. He is also never seen {{pkmn2|caught|catching}} a {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Drowzee}}.
* Despite all {{OBP|Pokémon hunters|JN053}} being present, their {{p|Weezing}} and {{p|Garbodor}} are never seen.
* The {{p|Pidgey}} that befriended {{TP|Goh|Suicune}} is omitted.
